import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int SIZE = (1 << 21) + 1;
    static final int p = 1000000007;
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static int n;
    static long[][] f = new long[11][131];
    static long[] a = new long[11];
    static int[] is = new int[131];
    static long i100;
    static Map<LLL, Integer>[] st = new HashMap[8];
    static long[,] mx = new long[1];
    static LongHashSet[,] sets;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            st[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
    }

    static class LLL {
        long a, b;

        void set(int x) {
            if (x < 64) a |= 1L << x;
            else b |= 1L << (x - 64);
        }

        void reset() {
            a = 0; b = 0;
        }

        LLL or(LLL ano) {
            this.a |= ano.a;
            this.b |= ano.b;
            return this;
        }

        boolean equals(LLL ano) {
            return this.a == ano.a && this.b == ano.b;
        }

        boolean get(int ano) {
            if (ano < 64)
                return (a & (1L << ano)) != 0;
            else
                return (b & (1L << (ano - 64))) != 0;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(a, b);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (!(obj instanceof LLL)) return false;
            return equals((LLL) obj);
        }
    }

    public static int dfs(int x, LLL w, Map<LLL, Integer>[] st, long[] mx, int n, long[][] f, List<LLL>[] s) {
        if (x == n) return w.equals(mx[0]) ? 1 : 0;
        if (st[x].containsKey(w)) return st[x].get(w);
        int ans = 0;
        LLL ng = new LLL();
        LLL[] sArrays = new LLL[n];
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) sArrays[j] = new LLL();

        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            sArrays[j].reset();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            if (w.get(i)) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (!(i & (1 << j))) {
                        sArrays[j].set(i | (1 << j));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            ng.reset();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ((i & (1 << j))) {
                    ng.or(sArrays[j]);
                }
            }
            long temp = (f[x][i] * dfs(x + 1, ng, st, mx, n, f, s)) % p;
            ans = (ans + (int) temp) % p;
        }
        st[x].put(w, ans);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer stToken = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(stToken.nextToken());
        Arrays.fill(is, -1);
        long[] mxArray = new long[1];
        mxArray[0] = 0;
        long[] mxRef = new long[]{mxArray[0]};
        Set<Long> mxSet = new HashSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            if ((i & (i - 1)) == 0)
                setBit(mxSet, i);
        }

        long inv100 = fpm(100, p - 2);
        a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            stToken = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                long val = Long.parseLong(stToken.nextToken());
                a[i] = val * inv100 % p;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            is[1 << i] = i;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                long res = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if ((j & (1 << k)) != 0)
                        res = res * a[k] % p;
                    else
                        res = res * (p + 1 - a[k]) % p;
                }
                f[i][j] = res;
            }
        }

        // Prepare the 's' array for dfs
        List<LLL>[] s = new ArrayList[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s[i].clear();
        }

        // Call dfs
        Map<LLL, Integer>[] stArr = new HashMap[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) stArr[i] = new HashMap<>();

        // create initial mx
        LLL initialMx = new LLL();
        initialMx.reset();
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            if (((i - 1) & i) == 0) // i is a power of two or zero
                initialMx.set(i);
        }
        mx[0] = initialMx;

        int result = dfs(0, new LLL(), stArr, mx, n, f, s);
        System.out.println(result);
    }

    static long fpm(long a, long b) {
        long c = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) c = c * a % p;
            a = a * a % p;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return c;
    }

    static void setBit(Set<Long> set, int x) {
        set.add((long) x);
    }
}
